judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking orographic cloud plume against a moody dark sky makes this a memorable, worth-keeping sky photo despite the plain foreground.
strengths: Dramatic banner/lenticular cloud streaming off the ridge
Strong tonal contrast between bright cloud and dark sky
Clean, simple composition with the ridge anchoring the frame
weaknesses: Upper sky is a flat, featureless dark wash
Foreground snow is plain and adds little
Slightly tight crop on the cloud's rightward tail
